item.title: Accounts Payable Ignoring Your Invoice? The Hold Music
item.description: Three emails to accounts payable, no reply, and you're in a hospital corridor with your phone. A calm story about chasing money without feeling like you're begging.

item.title: Backup Says Success, Folder Empty? The Spilled Latte
item.description: The scheduler said 'completed successfully'. The backup folder says nothing at all. A calm story about trusting your backup again, one logfile at a time.

item.title: Can't Tell Which Hours You Invoiced? The Beehive Veil
item.description: A phone buzzes mid-beehive-inspection and you can't say which hours you already billed. A short story about getting that certainty back.

item.title: Client Agreed to Pay, Stopped Replying? The Scoreboard
item.description: They said yes, the money was coming. Then silence. A story about a Saturday spent refreshing your inbox, and what calmer follow-up feels like.

item.title: Client Promised to Pay, Now Won't Answer? Kilometre 30
item.description: They swore the money was coming, then went quiet. A freelancer, a marathon crowd and a phone that stays silent: when chasing feels like begging.

item.title: CSV Header Repeated Mid-File? The Dance Studio Lobby
item.description: The header row shows up again halfway down the CSV, and pandas turns every number into text. A Saturday-morning story about getting calm back.

item.title: CSV Line Breaks Splitting Rows? The Loading Bay Thursday
item.description: Half-rows, a stray line of text in column A, and a courier waiting at the door. A small story about CSV line breaks inside cells, and the calm after.

item.title: CSV Mixed Dates and Duplicates, No Time? The Badge Table
item.description: Three date formats, doubled names, and a coach leaving at ten. A short story about a messy CSV and what a calmer morning could feel like.

item.title: Thought It Was in Stock, It Wasn't? The Treatment Table
item.description: Face down on a physio table, your phone lights up: six jars ordered, and you're not sure you have six. A calm story about stock that stops surprising you.

item.title: Forgot to Keep a Mileage Log? The Odometer in the Lay-by
item.description: It's November and you never kept a mileage log. A short story about the odometer, the calendar, and finding a calm way back into your year-end admin.

item.title: Handyman Hourly Rate Too High? The Village Hall Chairs
item.description: Wednesday evening, a committee waiting, and the question every handyman dreads: what's your hourly rate? A short story about finding a number you can say calmly.

item.title: Music Teacher Unsure What You Earn? The Letting Desk
item.description: A letting agent asks what you earn a month from lessons, and you realise you don't know. A calm story for private music teachers.

item.title: Passwords and Tokens in Your API Logs? The Ski Boot Queue
item.description: You found a token in your API logs while standing in a ski-boot queue, and now you wonder what else you missed. A calm story about that feeling.

item.title: Ran Out of Materials Mid-Order? The Empty Thread Spool
item.description: Halfway through 40 hand-bound notebooks, the thread runs out. A calm story for makers who found out too late, and what a quiet Monday looks like instead.

item.title: Hairdresser Forgot to Charge for an Extra? The Toner Pot
item.description: You added a toner on Saturday and never rang it up. Monday morning, the numbers say so. A calm story for solo stylists who undercharge by accident.

item.title: Swagger Docs Exposed in Production? The Spare Key Label
item.description: Your Swagger page is public and a message just landed. A calm story about the knot in your stomach, and how to stop guessing while you stand in a queue.

item.title: Another Year Gone, Freelance Going Nowhere? The Clock Shop
item.description: December is close and the year feels wasted. A quiet scene in a clock shop about slow progress you can't see, and a calmer way to start 2027.

item.title: API Returning Stack Traces in Production? The Kiosk Queue
item.description: A screenshot of your API's error page lands in a client's message at 8:50 on a Monday. Is the stack trace showing too much? A calm story and a way forward.

item.title: Cancelled Lessons, Lost Make-Ups? The Lightbulb Aisle
item.description: You cancelled a week of tutoring and now can't remember which make-up lessons you owe. A quiet story from the hardware aisle, and a calmer way to keep track.

item.title: Client Pushing Back on Your Price? The Ticket Inspector
item.description: Third email about your price, and you're on a train with a draft you can't send. A calm story about replying without caving or snapping.

item.title: CSV Commas Shifting Columns? The Changing Room Bench
item.description: A comma in an address field and suddenly every column is off by one. A calm story about messy CSV imports, and what a quiet Monday looks like without them.

item.title: CSV File Keeps Breaking My Import? The Tide Table
item.description: The import rejects your CSV for the fourth time and the client launch is at noon. A calm story about breaking out of the fix-and-retry loop.

item.title: Materials Markup Too High? The Call Over a Cold Flask
item.description: The customer says your materials markup is too high and your tea goes cold. A quiet story about answering calmly, and knowing your real margin.

item.title: Freelance Receipts Unsorted in December? The Costume Queue
item.description: It's December and you haven't touched your freelance receipts. A quiet story from a school hall queue about how the knot loosens when there's one place.

item.title: Didn't Track Business Expenses All Year? The Hill Walk
item.description: November, a hill walk, and the thought you've dodged since March: you never tracked your expenses. A calm story about starting late, with no shame.

item.title: Downloads Folder Chaos? Embarrassed to Share Your Screen
item.description: Thousands of files in Downloads and a student waiting on your screen share. A calm story for anyone who has hovered over the share button and flinched.

item.title: First Year Self-Employed, What Paperwork Do I Keep?
item.description: Eight months freelancing, a carrier bag of paper and one question you're afraid to ask: what do I actually keep? A calm story about the first year.

item.title: Freelance Business a Mess? The Map at the Info Desk
item.description: Your freelance business feels like a mess and you don't know where to start. A short story about a holiday that isn't one, and a map that says: you are here.

item.title: Invoice Rejected, No PO Number? The Village Shop Signal
item.description: Your invoice bounced back for a missing PO number and payment slips again. A quiet story about chasing money without feeling like you're begging.

item.title: Job Offer Due Tomorrow, Can't Recall Other Interviews?
item.description: The offer expires tomorrow at noon and the other interviews have blurred into one. A Saturday-morning story about getting your own notes back.

item.title: Negative Google Review? The Shutter Half Up on Monday
item.description: One star at 7:45 on a Monday, coffee still hot. A story for small business owners who want to reply to a bad Google review without sounding defensive.

item.title: Quoted Too Cheap, Materials Eating Profit? The Pickup Line
item.description: You quoted a garden job from memory and the receipts in the cup holder say the materials ate your profit. A calm story about seeing it before it happens.

item.title: Rainy Market Day, Barely Covered Pitch Fee? Any Profit?
item.description: Rain all day, and the takings barely covered the pitch fee. Did you make any profit at the market? A quiet story about knowing instead of guessing.

item.title: Client Wants a Rush Translation Today? What to Charge
item.description: A same-day translation request lands while you're at the regatta clubhouse, and you freeze on the price. A calm story about charging for rush work.

item.title: Worried About 2027 Freelance Income? The Lease Renewal
item.description: The lease renewal letter asks one simple question: can you commit to next year? A calm story for freelancers whose income is unpredictable.

item.title: Worried About SQL Injection in Your API? Smoothie Bar
item.description: A client asks if your API is safe from SQL injection while you wait for a smoothie. You say yes, but you can't be sure. Here's a calmer way to know.

item.title: API Key Visible in Frontend Code? The Tasting Table Text
item.description: A message from a client's nephew, a key in the browser, and a knot in your stomach. A calm story for anyone asking whether an exposed API key is trouble.

item.title: API Returns Too Much Data? The Window Envelope Call
item.description: A screen-share, a network tab, and one JSON field nobody meant to send. A calm story for developers who worry their API says more than it should.

item.title: Client Missed the Payment Run? The Hallway Paint Roller
item.description: Your client missed the payment run and the invoice is still open. A story about the knot in your stomach, and a calmer way to follow up.

item.title: CSV Decimal Comma Won't Add Up in Excel? The Balcony Sum
item.description: The total says 0, the numbers sit on the left, the report is due at five. A story about decimal commas in a CSV – and getting the afternoon back.

item.title: CSV Junk Header Rows Breaking Import? The Blood Test Queue
item.description: The export has report titles on top and a total line at the bottom, and your import keeps failing. A quiet story about a morning like that, and the way out.

item.title: CSV Messy Dates and Duplicates, Due Today? The 9:05 Text
item.description: A CSV full of mixed dates and duplicates, and the client wants it by five. A short story about the knot in your stomach, and what a calmer Thursday feels like.

item.title: Customer Won't Pay a Materials Deposit? The Utility Room
item.description: The customer says they'll pay when it's done, and the supplier wants cash now. A quiet story for tradespeople stuck funding the materials.

item.title: Excel Shows Dates as 45231 After CSV Import? Breakfast Room
item.description: 7:45 in a hotel breakfast room, the CSV opens and every date is a five-digit number. A calm story about the 45231 problem and the morning after.

item.title: Sent Your First Freelance Invoice? The Gift-Wrap Counter
item.description: You sent your first freelance invoice and now wonder what's missing. A lunchtime story about that wobble, and a calmer way to send the next one.

item.title: Freelance Receipts, What Accountant Needs? The Slipway
item.description: Your accountant asks for 'everything' and you have a shoebox, three inboxes and a phone full of photos. A calm story about finally knowing what goes where.

item.title: Freelancer Quarterly Taxes Panic? The Quiet Coach, 8:40
item.description: A deadline reminder, a half-empty account and no idea how much to set aside. A short story about freelancer quarterly taxes and finding calm.

item.title: How Much Safety Stock Is Enough? The Recital Row
item.description: You sit in a folding chair at a recital, doing stock maths in your head. How much safety stock should a small shop keep? A calmer way to stop guessing.

item.title: How Much to Charge for Handmade Jewelry? The Deli Queue
item.description: A stranger admires your ring and asks the price. You hear yourself say a number you made up. For makers who feel like they're just guessing.

item.title: Checking Your Bank for a Client's Payment? The Bus Tour
item.description: You swipe to your banking app for the ninth time today, waiting for a client's payment. A story about the knot behind the refresh, and a calmer way to wait.
